fixes_applied: Boot/upload race fixed: IndexedDB documents now merge after core database load.
Evidence rendering escaped to prevent uploaded text/HTML from breaking the result page.
Saved-query rendering hardened; quotes/HTML in searches can no longer break click behavior.
Service worker changed to network-first for app/JSON: new GitHub deployments are not hidden by stale cache.
limitations: Image OCR and PDF extraction libraries are fetched from external CDNs on first use, so first-time OCR/PDF parsing needs internet.
No static test can guarantee behavior on every browser/device; the app now contains runtime fallbacks and built-in smoke tests for core search.
